meta.description: Weekly dengue cases, DOH thresholds and EARS results per HDX reporting unit (2016-2021). Retrospective prototype output, not a validated public-health claim.
meta.source: HDX - Philippine Dengue Cases and Deaths (Cirrolytix; DOH Epidemiology Bureau data), CC BY
meta.weekNote: Week = the HDX `date` value, taken as the week start. Its meaning is unconfirmed; it lines up best with OpenDengue shifted 1-2 weeks earlier.
meta.doh: Alert = mean of the same epi week in the 3 previous years + 1 SD; epidemic = mean + 2 SD (DOH PIDSR Manual of Procedures, 3rd ed., s. 5.3.5). From 2019.
assumptions: Province rows are assumed to exclude their separately reported cities (supported, not proven).
Counts are assumed to be by place of residence (unconfirmed).
Suspected cases/deaths swap rows (Sep-Oct 2016, 2017, 2020) and missing weeks are no data.
